## Following the Nagoya Opening on August 22, the Brand Enters the Kansai Region for the First Time, Bringing “Accessible Trend Beauty” to Kobe


**IRVINE, Calif. — SBC Medical Group Holdings, Inc. (“SBC”), a Medical Services Organization that provides management support to medical institutions in Japan and overseas, today announced that NEO Skin Clinic Kobe will open on Saturday, August 29, 2026, in the Sannomiya area of Chuo-ku, Kobe. The clinic is the fourth location for NEO Skin Clinic, an aesthetic dermatology brand built on the concept of “accessible trend beauty, bringing the skin care trending in Korea closer to home.”**


Aesthetic dermatology is a field in which new treatment devices and pharmaceuticals appear in rapid succession and trends shift quickly. NEO Skin Clinic offers more than 50 treatment options using the latest devices from Japan and Korea, and updates its lineup on an ongoing basis. At a free consultation, the VISIA skin analysis system is used to quantify the condition of the skin, and a physician then proposes a customized treatment plan that also reflects the customer’s own preferences.


Following Ebisu, Ginza and Nagoya, the Kobe clinic is the brand’s fourth location and its first in the Kansai region. It is a one-minute walk from West Exit 3 of Sannomiya Station on the Kobe Municipal Subway Seishin-Yamate Line, and within a five-minute walk of the Hankyu, JR and Hanshin lines. Situated at the center of the Sannomiya area, where four railway lines converge, the clinic is easy to visit between work or shopping. Skin care programs are generally carried out over a series of visits, and a location that is convenient to reach is one factor that supports continuing that routine.


To mark the opening, the clinic will run an opening campaign from Saturday, August 29, 2026 through Saturday, November 28, 2026. Details of the treatments covered and their prices are available on the official website below.
[https://www.sbc-neoskinclinic.jp/campaign-kobe/](https://www.sbc-neoskinclinic.jp/campaign-kobe/)

SBC is diversifying its business to meet increasingly varied customer needs, and one pillar of that effort is a multi-brand strategy in aesthetic healthcare. Centered on Shonan Beauty Clinic, which covers comprehensive aesthetic healthcare, SBC operates brands separated by clinical field and customer segment. These include NEO Skin Clinic, an aesthetic dermatology brand for customers attuned to current trends; Hada no Aozora Clinic, a hybrid dermatology brand offering both insured and self-pay care so that customers who find aesthetic healthcare daunting can more easily begin; Shonan Beauty Clinic THE LASER, which specializes in hair removal; and SBC MEN’S FLASH CLINIC, a men’s brand specializing in beard hair removal. SBC will continue to build an environment in which each customer can more easily choose the care that suits them, and to support people in living healthily and true to themselves.


**About SBC Medical Group Holdings, Inc.**
SBC Medical Group Holdings, Inc. is a Medical Services Organization that provides management support to medical institutions in Japan and overseas across a wide range of fields, including advanced aesthetic healthcare, dermatology, orthopedics, reproductive medicine, gynecology, dentistry, hair loss treatment (AGA) and ophthalmology. The company operates a portfolio of clinic brands and is expanding into medical tourism as well as the United States and Asia. SBC listed on the NASDAQ market in the United States in September 2024, and was added to the Russell 3000 Index in June 2025. Guided by its group purpose, to contribute to greater happiness for people around the world through medical innovation, SBC will continue to deliver reliable medical services and expand its network.
